argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$work='E:\PC-Control\Proxifier-Avito-20261012'
$orig=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Proxifier4\Profiles\Default.ppx'
$backup=Join-Path $work 'Default-original-backup.ppx'
$staged=Join-Path $work 'SecondChrome-Direct-PIDs.ppx'
$exe='C:\Program Files (x86)\Proxifier\Proxifier.exe'
if(!(Test-Path $staged) -or !(Test-Path $backup) -or ((Get-FileHash $orig).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash $backup).Hash)){throw 'PROFILE_CHANGED_ABORT'}
[xml]$stagedXml=Get-Content -LiteralPath $staged -Raw
$rule=$stagedXml.SelectNodes('//*[local-name()="Rule"]')[0]
if($rule.SelectSingleNode('./Name').InnerText -ne 'Second Chrome DIRECT [session]' -or $rule.SelectSingleNode('./Action').GetAttribute('type') -ne 'Direct'){throw 'RULE_MISMATCH_ABORT'}
$pids=@([regex]::Matches($rule.SelectSingleNode('./Applications').InnerText,'pid=(\d+)')|ForEach-Object{[int]$_.Groups[1].Value})
if((16760 -in $pids) -or !(9148 -in $pids) -or !(9316 -in $pids)){throw 'PID_SCOPE_INVALID_ABORT'}
$c=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='chrome.exe'")
if(!($c|Where-Object {$_.ProcessId -eq 9148 -and $_.CommandLine -notmatch '--type='}) -or !($c|Where-Object {$_.ProcessId -eq 9316 -and $_.CommandLine -match 'remote-debugging-port=17447'})){throw 'TARGET_CHROME_RESTARTED_ABORT'}
$restorer=Join-Path $work 'RESTORE_DEFAULT_PROXIFIER.cmd'
$restoreCmd='@echo off'+[Environment]::NewLine+'"'+$exe+'" "'+$backup+'" silent-load'+[Environment]::NewLine+'echo Requested restore of original Proxifier profile.'+[Environment]::NewLine
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($restorer,$restoreCmd,[System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
$oldPid=(Get-Process Proxifier -ErrorAction Stop|Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Id)
$p=Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList ('"'+$staged+'" silent-load') -PassThru -Wait
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
$after=Get-Process Proxifier -ErrorAction Stop|Select-Object -First 1
$o=[ordered]@{stage='requested_live_activation';profileStaged=$true;originalBackupStillUnchanged=((Get-FileHash $orig).Hash -eq (Get-FileHash $backup).Hash);proxifierMainPidBefore=$oldPid;proxifierMainPidAfter=$after.Id;loadCommandExitCode=$p.ExitCode;restoreCommandExists=(Test-Path $restorer);restoreCommandPath=$restorer;ruleScopePidCount=$pids.Count;defaultRuleUnchanged=$true}
$o|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5
